{{Lunisolar September}} 
'''September 10''' is the 10th day of month {{ill|September (Lunisolar)|ja|9月 (旧暦)|lt=September (Nagatsuki)}}  the 9th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|Shakkō|ja|赤口|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11635368}} . 

== Events ==
* {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}}  13 ({{ill|Julian calendar|en|Julian calendar|qid=Q11184|lt=Julian calendar}}  {{ill|685|en|685|qid=Q33480|lt=685}}  {{ill|October 13|en|October 13|qid=Q2925|lt=October 13}} ) – {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|en|Ise Shrine|qid=Q687168|lt=Ise Grand Shrine}}  establishes the tradition of rebuilding its main sanctuary every 20 years, known as {{ill|Jingū Shikinen Sengū|ja|式年遷宮|lt=Shikinen Sengu}} .
* {{ill|世宗|en|世宗|qid=Q124369479|lt=Sejong the Great}}  28 (Julian {{ill|1446|en|1446|qid=Q6430|lt=1446}}  {{ill|October 9|en|October 9|qid=Q2923|lt=October 9}} ) – King {{ill|Sejong the Great|en|Sejong the Great|qid=Q37682|lt=Sejong the Great}}  of {{ill|Joseon|en|Joseon|qid=Q28179|lt=Joseon}}  distributes the explanatory book on {{ill|Hangul|en|Hangul|qid=Q8222|lt=Hangul}} , 『{{ill|Hunminjeongeum|en|Hunminjeongeum|qid=Q18990|lt=Hunminjeongeum}} 』 (Hangul Day).
* {{ill|Eiroku|en|Eiroku|qid=Q1143341|lt=Eiroku}}  4 (Julian {{ill|1561|en|1561|qid=Q6618|lt=1561}}  {{ill|October 18|en|October 18|qid=Q2964|lt=October 18}} ) – The fiercest battle of the {{ill|Battles of Kawanakajima|en|Battles of Kawanakajima|qid=Q1143044|lt=Battle of Kawanakajima}}  occurs (known as the Battle of Hachimanbara).
